criteria.statement: Every execution route passes through central policy.
criteria.gap: Special routes still need the common execution envelope.

criteria.statement: ToolResult distinguishes execution, effect, verification, and rollback.
criteria.gap: The v2 contract exists, but several tools still use legacy normalization.

criteria.statement: Sensitive actions respect the immutable permission floor and request origin.
PermissionStore, memory, and runtime state publish atomically and fail closed.
Audio, session, vision, dashboard, and shutdown have a documented owner.
criteria.gap: Dashboard and global shutdown ownership remain distributed.

criteria.statement: Workers start, cancel, stop, and restart without leaking resources.
criteria.gap: Browser and vision are supervised pilots; other action workers remain legacy.

criteria.statement: Critical flags have one writer or a single mutation API.
criteria.gap: The extracted owners are covered, but the remaining legacy flags are not fully inventoried.

criteria.statement: Wake preserves a single instance and microphone recovery.
criteria.gap: Static and mocked checks pass; acoustic hardware recovery still needs observation.
The central tool path is correlated; non-tool and remaining special entries need a complete inventory.

criteria.statement: Every tool records policy, duration, result, evidence, and verification.
criteria.gap: Legacy-normalized tools do not all produce observed evidence and verification.

criteria.statement: Logs sanitize secrets and omit sensitive bodies.
Logging failure does not prevent startup.
The UI emits commands and consumes snapshots.
criteria.gap: The migrated tool boundary is covered; remaining legacy UI flows need inventory.

criteria.statement: AI actions depend on provider interfaces.
criteria.gap: Web search is the pilot; text, Live, and vision actions still need migration.

criteria.statement: QML is adopted only after a passing benchmark.
Changes include unit, integration, and smoke coverage.
Latency stays within the agreed baseline.
criteria.gap: Wake, audio interruption, local-tool, reconnect, and shutdown targets still need real runtime measurements.
Phased changes document rollback, but there is no repository-wide enforcement for every future sensitive change.

criteria.statement: Priority fault injection is validated before legacy removal.
criteria.gap: Priority pilots have fault injection; legacy adapters have not all reached removal criteria.
